basic_info.description: 4 unit building located just two blocks from Lincoln Park, Legion of Honor, Lands End, both Clement St and Geary Blvd shops and restaurant, and Ocean Beach! Each floor features a one bedroom one bath and a two bedroom one bath unit from front to back. Both units on the top floor are tenant-occupied while the lower floor is vacant.  These units are identical on the two flats. Ground floor offers coin-operated laundry, full garage with parking in the rear yard. Great building for passive income investment!
